full_text: Article 2 (Date of Enforcement of the Act Partially Amending the Criminal Procedure Act) The Act Partially Amending the Criminal Procedure Act (Act No. 16924) enters into force on January 1, 2021; provided, the amended provisions of Article 312 (1) enter into force on January 1, 2022.
